space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4px grid. The key is the multiplier of 4px (space.4 = 16px).

radius.$description: Subtle corners only (v2): nothing rounder than 8px, no pill or circle shapes.

xs.$description: Focus ring, switch knob, tiny details.

sm.$description: Badges and labels, the logo in the header.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, chips, tabs, switch, thumbnails.

xl.$description: Largest corner: the logo on the login screen.

mono.$value: 'Inconsolata Variable', 'Inconsolata', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Inconsolata (SIL Open Font License), a variable font with weight (200-900) and width (50-200%) axes. Bundled with the app from the @fontsource-variable/inconsolata package, so it works offline and is not loaded from Google. System monospace fonts are the fallback.

size-adjust.$description: CSS font-size-adjust: scales the font so its lowercase letters are half the font size. Inconsolata's lowercase is only 0.46, so this makes it about 9% larger and as legible as a typical sans-serif at the same font size. Also keeps fallback fonts the same visual size. Change it if the font changes.

size.$description: Readability floor since v1.1: nothing below 13px, running text at 15px or more.

condensed.$description: Article titles. Was 92 in v1.0; slightly wider letters read more easily.

base.$description: Running text. More air between lines for easier reading.

icon-xs.$description: Icons inside a line of text: link arrow, chip icons, remove buttons.

icon-md.$description: Tab icons on phones. Pictogrammers icons are drawn on a 24px grid.

content-max.$description: Maximum width of the reading column.

measure.$description: Maximum line length for running text.

breakpoint.$description: CSS cannot read custom properties inside @media. These are emitted to TS and JSON, and mirrored by hand in CSS. See docs/usage.md.

standard.$description: Smooth ease-out: quick start, gentle stop.
